Name: cavern_jackals
name: The Jackals of the Caverns
leaders: Nidnusha the Jackal;Ahum One-Ear;Kuri the Younger
description: Runaway debt-slaves, deserters and tomb robbers living in the caverns of the desert scarp; they rob the salt road, pick the date grove and sell grave goods to anyone who does not ask.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); mechanics.md row 11 (minor factions: drought raiders); row 12 (outlawry); laws.csv tomb_robbery; regions.csv south plan 1 (rocky caverns)

Name: reed_men
name: The Reed Men
leaders: Ur-Gigir the Runaway;Belessunu of the Reeds;Shu-Ninua
description: Marsh folk and debtors who fled into the swamp when the drought took their plots; they move by reed boat, lift sheep from the grazing lands and vanish between the islands.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §4.1 (the drought that is breaking the world); regions.csv west plan 1 (swamps and wetlands); mechanics.md row 11

Name: eastern_warband
name: The Warband of the Eastern Road
leaders: Kharzu Bull-Horn;Tiggun the Burnt;Zaqar son of Kharzu
description: Cattle nomads of the eastern mountains turned warriors by the breaking of the world: they ride down the eastern road for grain and herds, burn what they cannot carry and move on west.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); CANON basis: wb §4.1 (foreigners from the east raid the cities); wb §4.3 (cattle nomads turned warrior people; survival by new lands in the west); factions.csv the_barbarians; notes L15;L20-21

Name: suti_riders
name: The Sutean Riders
leaders: Yadih-El of the Wells;Ammi-Shaduqa;Zimri of the Sand
description: Desert riders who water at the Sutean wells; when the south burns they come north for flocks and for the salt caravans, and they suffer no rival on their wells.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); CANON basis: factions.csv suti (reign alone in the South); regions.csv south plan 2; notes L143; A: the Suteans, raiding nomads of the Old Babylonian steppe

Name: sons_of_the_swamp_sage
name: The Sons of the Swamp Sage
leaders: Lu-Utu the Zealot;Ninshubur-ama;Ur-Nanshe of the Ford
description: Zealots sworn to the sage of the swamps who take the war to the Empire's roads: they fall only on caravans of the Empire and on eastern raiders, never on the fields of the south.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); CANON basis: wb §4.2 (unite the city states; push back the invading barbarians); factions.csv neo_sumerian_rebellion; notes L18-19;L104
